description:
Zero deposit option available

Welcome to Sherborne Place

Step inside our beautifully designed apartments and you'll find yourself surrounded by top-of-the-line finishes and sleek modern features. With a range of floor plans to choose from, you're sure to find the perfect layout to suit your needs. Our living areas are ideal for entertaining guests or simply relaxing after a long day, while our fully equipped kitchens offer everything you need to whip up a gourmet meal.

Sherborne Place sits adjacent to the bustling Brindley Place, a thriving hub of activity and entertainment in Birmingham. Your new home offers easy access to the vibrant scene of restaurants, shops, cultural spots, and more right at your doorstep. 

Inside your new home, you'll get:
* A spacious open-plan kitchen/living area with modern appliances; full height fridge/freezer, oven, electric hob, washer/dryer and dishwasher
* Large family bathroom
* Fully furnished; double beds, mattresses, wardrobes, bedside units, dining table and chairs, a large sofa, arm chair, media unit and coffee table
* Floor to ceiling windows with Juliette balcony 

That's not all, you'll also benefit from all of these Neighbourhood perks:
* Professional management and friendly 24/7 on-site team
* Purrfectly pet-friendly apartments with no added costs
* On-site maintenance, here to help when you need them
* Complimentary access to on-site Resident' Lounge and Co-working Space
* Resident events, puppy yoga or resident parties - you control the calendar
* Exclusive local and nationwide discounts such as money off your Gym Group membership or spice up your meal times with a free trial of Simply Cook.
* The option to paint feature walls, make your apartment truly yours
* Secure car parking spaces available to rent

With plenty of transport options and local attractions nearby:

Transport:
*9-minute train to Birmingham International Airport from Birmingham New Street Station
*14-minute walk to Five Ways Train Station
*17-minute walk to Birmingham New Street Train Station
*23-minute walk to Snow Hill Train Station

Local shops & attractions:
*2-minute walk to Brindley Place 
*4-minute walk to Sherborne Wharf
*4-minute walk to Broad Street
*5-minute walk to Tesco Express, Sheepcote Street
*6-minute walk to Sainsbury's Local, Brindley Place
*7-minute walk to Birmingham Sea Life Centre 
*9-minute walk to Broadway Plaza
*10-minute walk to Bullring Shopping Centre 
*13-minute walk to Morrisons Supermarket 
*13-minute walk to City Gardens 
*19-minute walk to Newhall Street Tavern, where residents can enjoy 50% off Interactive Shuffleboard (Mon-Thurs)
*20-minute walk to The Rectory & 180 Club, where residents can enjoy 50% off Interactive Darts (Mon-Thurs)
*20-minute walk to STRONG Pilates, where residents receive 10% off memberships and class packs
*21-minute walk to Tonight Josephine, where residents can enjoy discounts on drinks & brunches
*22-minute walk to The Cocktail Club, where residents can enjoy discounted drinks
*22-minute walk to The Button Factory, where residents can get 10% discount on food when pre-booked

Be fully at home, at Sherborne Place. Book your viewing to come see it for yourself.

Your Home, By ila





Disclaimer: Whilst every attempt has been made to ensure the accuracy of the photographs, virtual tours, and floor plans presented on this listing, they are for illustrative purposes only and may not accurately reflect the actual size, layout, or furniture included. Please note that furnishings and decor are not included unless explicitly stated in the listing description. Interested parties are advised to speak to the Sherborne Place team for any clarity or further information
